svg.title: Where each transformation fact lives and what proves it
svg.desc: Two columns. Facts that live in Git, such as a namespace field in a kustomization file, images in a kustomization file and the placeholders in a manifest: they are covered by the base commit and are proven again by rendering the tree at the branch head before every commit. Only the value of a file namespace is also bound in the digest, because it decides identity. Facts that live only in the cluster, such as the Flux spec.targetNamespace and spec.postBuild of the Kustomization and the names of its substituteFrom references (no ConfigMap is read): the render cannot see them, so the source mapping records them in status.source, the plan digest covers them, and the freshness check maps again, compares the transforms entries and supersedes the request when they differ. Flux spec.images is context only: the entry records that the list is set, never its content. Both columns end at the same gate: a pull request that a person merges.
svg.text: namespace: and images: in a kustomization file,
Read at the base commit, covered by baseCommit. Only a namespace:
value is bound in the digest; images content is not (bumps stay valid).
Not in any file, so the render cannot see them.
Recorded in status.source and the digest; images only as context.
Proof: render the tree at the branch head
With and without the change. Only the edited field may differ.
Already built for plain trees and in-repo transformers (semantic diff).
Proof: map again, compare the transforms
The freshness check resolves the source again. Other transforms
than recorded: the request is Superseded. Proposed (task 1a).
Neither column reads a Secret. No decision compares times from two clocks: Git facts are pinned by commit, cluster facts by UID and an equality check.
